steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v7
Build the production image on its native architecture
Start an isolated test cluster without published ports
Add minimal test dependencies to the disposable container
Verify actual backup, settings before COPY, staging and rollback
Verify checkpoint restore, cancellation, queries and startup indexes
Verify production history readers on heap and mixed partitions
Remove the isolated cluster and anonymous data volume
Post Run actions/checkout@v7
Complete job
